question: Which group first introduced formal nursing training in Nigeria?
explanation: Religious missions established the earliest hospitals and began training local personnel to assist in healthcare delivery. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h1)

question: Moving nursing programs into universities and polytechnics changed training by emphasizing what?

options.B: Reduced clinical hours for all students
options.D: Faster completion times for hospital wards

explanation: Tertiary education elevated the status of nursing by replacing informal ward apprenticeships with structured academic degrees. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h1)

question: What is a primary local pressure driving changes in Nigerian nursing education?

options.A: Strict bans on using medical equipment
options.C: A complete absence of hospitalized patients
options.D: Rising patient loads and complex health needs

explanation: Growing populations and complex disease profiles force training programs to prepare nurses for heavier and more demanding workloads. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h2)

question: A hospital adopts a new digital patient record system, requiring nurses to update care plans on tablets. This scenario responds to which driver of reform?
explanation: Digital transformation in clinical environments requires modern nurses to master new technology alongside patient care. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h2)

question: Modern nursing curricula have shifted focus from a disease-centered model to what kind of framework?
explanation: Current educational designs prioritize the whole person and community wellness rather than just treating an isolated disease pathology. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h3)

question: Why do nursing schools increasingly utilize clinical simulation laboratories?

options.A: To let students practice high-risk procedures safely
options.B: To replace all mandatory hospital clinical postings
options.C: To eliminate theoretical classroom lectures entirely
options.D: To reduce the number of qualified instructors needed

explanation: Simulators provide a controlled environment where learners can build confidence and competence without risking patient safety. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h3)

question: What is the official body responsible for regulating nursing education and practice in Nigeria?

options.C: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: The NMCN is the statutory body empowered by law to regulate all aspects of nursing training and practice in the country. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h4)

question: Which activity falls directly under the regulatory duties of the NMCN?

options.A: Appointing chief medical directors for teaching hospitals

explanation: The council is tasked with testing candidates and issuing valid licenses to ensure only qualified individuals practice. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h4)

question: What requirement ensures that licensed nurses keep their skills updated throughout their careers?
explanation: MCPD workshops and seminars help practitioners stay abreast of new clinical guidelines and medical advancements. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h5)

question: Why has clinical practice shifted toward evidence-based decision-making?

options.A: To reduce the number of hours spent documenting notes
options.B: To eliminate the need for physician consultations
options.C: To base patient care on proven scientific research
options.D: To rely more on personal opinions of senior staff

explanation: Evidence-based practice ensures that clinical interventions yield the best possible health outcomes using verified research. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h5)

question: The mass migration of experienced nurses abroad is commonly referred to as what?
explanation: The loss of skilled professionals to other countries severely depletes local human resources for health and education. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h6)

question: Which factor is NOT a major barrier to implementing nursing reforms in Nigeria?

options.A: Excessive funding and abundant learning resources

explanation: Public institutions face severe underfunding and resource shortages, making excessive funding an incorrect barrier statement. [learn more](GST321_U8_T7#GST321_U8_T7_h6)
